title: Sales data
request: Total the sales by region, describe each column and make a sheet for the board.

features.title: Totals for each region
features.story: As the owner I can run one script and get the units and the revenue for each region.
acceptance: With a sales file that has three regions, the totals file has one row for each region.

features.title: Description of each column
features.story: As the owner I can read what each column of the sales file means.
acceptance: Every column of the sales file has a row in the description, with a plain meaning and an example value.
The description does not say anything about a column that the sales file does not have.

results.evidence: Quote from docs/columns.csv: Region,Where the sale happened,North.
Every row names a column of the sales file.

features.title: Sales sheet for the board
features.story: As the owner I can open a sheet of the sales that I can show the board.
acceptance: The sheet shows the units and the revenue for each region.
The sheet looks tidy and is something the owner would be happy to show.

results.evidence: Tidiness is a matter of taste.

spec.summary: Adds the totals, the column notes and a sheet.
